audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart claimed Vladimir wins Levels 2 and 3 while the whys for those same rows say the stage is even; the packet chart also reads Skill for rows 0-4.
audit.why: Mel pokes at 950 (Radiant Volley) and 1000 (Solar Snare) range while Vladimir's Transfusion is 600 and he has no dash; he cannot own levels 2-3. Both layers and the packet must agree.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 2 flipped to Skill in both phases[].side and win[], matching the existing whys and the packet chart. Vladimir's genuine ownership starts at first item (Riftmaker) and grows with two items, which is where the 59.35% win rate over 401 games comes from.

audit.why: Spikes read: level 6 Hemoplague, first item Riftmaker, two-item window. Mel's spikes are Solar Snare rank-ups, level 6 Golden Eclipse and first item.
audit.corrected: Left the spike timings alone; only the ability slots inside them were corrected.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content called Solar Snare her R, described Rebuttal as a 'reflect window' that punishes a big single hit, and offered 'pool-cancel of her ult'.
audit.why: Solar Snare is Mel's E (11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, 1000 range, roots at centre). Golden Eclipse is her R and is global (25000 range) — it hits Overwhelm-marked targets anywhere on the map, so leaving lane does not save you. Rebuttal reflects projectiles AND prevents damage outright; Vladimir has no projectile in his kit, so the reflect never triggers and the damage-immunity is the real problem — matching the mirror audit's finding that Sanguine Pool cannot be reflected.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] now names Solar Snare (E) with its cooldown and flags Golden Eclipse as global; spikes[3] and wants.foe[2] now describe Rebuttal as damage immunity to wait out rather than a reflect to avoid.

audit.why: Solar Snare at 11s rank 1 is the punishable window and the text already builds around it.
audit.corrected: Added the concrete 11s figure to phases[1].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[2].t 'Waste empowered Q on minions' carried a description about pooling for poke — a template mismatch duplicating dontsFull[0].
audit.why: The title is about Crimson Rush; the body should explain why.
audit.corrected: Rewrote dontsFull[2].d to explain the full-bar Transfusion window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The supplied missing-interaction 'Mel can cut your retreat with Rebuttal (W) and you have no dash' is not supported by Riot's text.
audit.why: Rebuttal is described as a barrier around Mel that reflects projectiles, prevents damage and grants movement speed — no terrain is created. The kit file's 'terrain' flag is a tooltip-parsing misfire.
audit.corrected: Not written to the page. The genuine no-dash point is that Vladimir's only disengage is Sanguine Pool on a 28s cooldown at rank 1, which is already covered.

edits.before: Pool answers his single biggest button — save it for exactly that. Only take the trade when Mel's Solar Snare is down.
edits.after: Pool's 2s untargetable eats Solar Snare (E) whole — save it for that. Trade only while her root is on its 11s cooldown.

edits.before: Respect her Solar Snare (R) — it roots and can set up a full Overwhelm burst — but your Hemoplague matches her damage. Level 6 stays even: hold Sanguine Pool for her R root so you don't eat the follow-up, and only commit R when she's already used her snare.
edits.after: Respect Solar Snare (E) — an 11s root that sets up a full Overwhelm burst — and note Golden Eclipse (R) is global, so her stacks kill you anywhere. Hold Sanguine Pool for the root, not for poke, and commit Hemoplague only after her snare is spent.

edits.before: You out-scale a squishy poke mage — one Hemoplague plus pool-cancel of her ult in a fight bursts her out. Just don't int into her W (Rebuttal) reflect window with a big single hit; let E stacks do the work instead.
edits.after: You out-scale a squishy poke mage — one Hemoplague plus Sanguine Pool through her combo bursts her out. Rebuttal prevents damage for its duration, so pause your combo instead of dumping Hemoplague into it and re-open when it drops.

edits.before: Reflect your biggest hit with Rebuttal to flip a trade
edits.after: Blank your Hemoplague with Rebuttal's damage immunity

edits.before: Pooling to dodge poke — the pool is your KA answer and your only escape; spending it on chip is fatal.
edits.after: Crimson Rush only fires at full bar — dumping it on a minion wave gives up your one real trade window.

notes: Confirms the mirror's systemic template bug from another angle: this entry described Rebuttal as a reflect to fear even though Vladimir has no projectile ability at all. The kit file's 'terrain' flag on Rebuttal contradicts Riot's own description and should not be trusted anywhere it appears in Mel matchups.
